questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Find next: BD, FH, JL, NP, ?
questions.exp: Pattern: each pair skips 3 letters and starts where previous left off plus 2. B-D, F-H, J-L, N-P, next R-T.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: If WATER is coded as YCVGT, how is FIRE coded in the same pattern?
questions.exp: Each letter shifted +2: W+2=Y,A+2=C,T+2=V,E+2=G,R+2=T. Similarly F+2=H,I+2=K,R+2=T,E+2=G = HKTG.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: A man walks 8km North, then 6km East. How far is he from his starting point?
questions.exp: Using Pythagoras: distance=√(8²+6²)=√(64+36)=√100=10km.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: In a row of 40 people, Sonia is 16th from the left. What is her position from the right?
questions.exp: Position from right = Total+1-Position from left = 41-16 = 25th.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Find the odd one: Delhi, Mumbai, Chandigarh, Kolkata
questions.exp: Delhi, Mumbai, and Kolkata are major metro cities that are state capitals or equivalent major hubs in their own right serving large populated states; Chandigarh is a Union Territory and a shared capital, not a full state capital like the others.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: P is the son of Q. Q is the sister of R. R is the father of S. How is P related to S?
questions.exp: Q is R's sister, R is S's father, so Q is S's aunt. P is Q's son, making P and S cousins.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Which number replaces the question mark? 5, 10, 20, 40, ?
questions.exp: Geometric series: ×2 each time. 40×2=80.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Delhi Police functions under the administrative control of:
questions.exp: Delhi Police operates under the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA), Government of India, unlike other state police forces under their respective state governments.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Who built the Red Fort in Delhi?
questions.exp: The Red Fort (Lal Qila) was built by Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan between 1638-1648 as the residence of the Mughal emperors.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: India's first Metro Rail system was launched in which city?
questions.exp: Kolkata Metro, inaugurated in 1984, was India's first metro rail system. Delhi Metro began operations in 2002.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Find next: 2, 9, 28, 65, ?
questions.exp: Pattern: n³+1. 1³+1=2,2³+1=9,3³+1=28,4³+1=65,5³+1=126. Closest matching pattern gives 126.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Pen : Write :: Knife : ?
questions.exp: A pen is used to write. A knife is used to cut. Same tool-function relationship.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: If South-West becomes North, what does North-East become?
questions.exp: Each direction is rotated 180°. North-East rotated 180° becomes South-West.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Find the odd one: 8, 27, 64, 100, 125
questions.exp: 8=2³, 27=3³, 64=4³, 125=5³ — all perfect cubes. 100 is not a perfect cube; it's the odd one.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: A is the father of B. C is the mother of D. B is the brother of D. How is A related to C?
questions.exp: B and D are siblings. A is B's father, C is D's mother. Since B and D are siblings, A and C are husband and wife.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Complete the series: A, D, I, P, ?
questions.exp: Position values are perfect squares: A(1²),D(4²? no)... Actually pattern: A=1,D=4,I=9,P=16 — these are 1²,2²,3²,4². Next is 5²=25th letter = Y.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: In a certain code, if RAIN is written as SBJO, how is SNOW written?
questions.exp: Each letter shifted +1: R+1=S,A+1=B,I+1=J,N+1=O. Similarly S+1=T,N+1=O,O+1=P,W+1=X = TOPX.

questions.subject: GK

questions.subject: Maths
questions.q: A and B can complete a work together in 12 days. A alone can do it in 20 days. In how many days can B alone complete the work?
questions.exp: Combined rate=1/12. A's rate=1/20. B's rate=1/12-1/20=5/60-3/60=2/60=1/30. B alone takes 30 days.

questions.q: If all police officers are disciplined, and all disciplined people are punctual, then:
opts: All punctual people are police officers
questions.exp: All A are B, all B are C → all A are C. All police officers are disciplined, all disciplined are punctual → all police officers are punctual.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: A clock shows 3:15. What is the angle between the hour and minute hands?
questions.exp: At 3:15, minute hand is at 90°(from 12), hour hand is at 3×30+15×0.5=90+7.5=97.5°. Difference=97.5-90=7.5°.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Find the odd one: Constable, Inspector, Sub-Inspector, Doctor
questions.exp: Constable, Inspector, and Sub-Inspector are all police ranks. Doctor is unrelated to police hierarchy — the odd one.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: In a row, X is 7th from the left and Y is 9th from the right. If there are 20 people in the row, how many people are between X and Y?
questions.exp: Y's position from left=20-9+1=12. People between X(7th) and Y(12th)=12-7-1=4.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Which figure completes the analogy: Circle is to Sphere as Square is to ?
questions.exp: A Circle in 2D becomes a Sphere in 3D. A Square in 2D becomes a Cube in 3D (same shape extended into 3 dimensions).

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Find next: J10, H8, F6, D4, ?
questions.exp: Letters go backward by 2 (J,H,F,D,B) and numbers decrease by 2 (10,8,6,4,2). Answer=B2.
